title: Chapter 994
paragraphs: Chapter 994
Episode 246. The Battle for Mithra Desert (4)
‘Heh, where to go now?’
Thud-! Thud-!
With an innocent face, Yona cut off the breath of the wriggling enemy Myeong tribe soldiers. Then, he pulled out an internal map of the Patlok that Eltiot had prepared in advance.
‘Sis really can't draw...’

The map was drawn based on the estimation of the 'Pibil' that the Blue Plutonian tribe had once taken over. Since Patlok and Pibil were fortresses constructed around the same time, some of the internal structure overlapped.
The Void Space Tracking Device.
Eltiot had predicted that this most vital device to the alliance would be on either the 6th or 5th floor.

Though now it's in the spotlight because of a specific property called Lafrarosa, originally, the void space tracking device wasn’t of much importance among the equipment installed in aerial fortresses.
It wasn't often used in battle, mainly used to track hidden or fleeing enemies. In Pibil’s case, the device was also installed on the 6th floor.
‘I'll have to break through one more floor. 20 minutes, no... more than 15 minutes would be dangerous. Within that time, I have to find something that my little brother will like, hee-hee!’
Screech-! Wail-!
An alarm sounding the invasion was ringing. The nearby Myeong tribe soldiers assembled and sealed off the 7th floor.
However, the initial emitted brainwave wave escaped through the cracks made by Jin and Luna, and Yona, as always, moved shadow-like, slipping past the Myeong tribe.
“Kraak!”
“Ugh!”
With every move of Yona, the Myeong tribesmen screamed their last breath.
For a while, they couldn't understand ‘why’ their brethren were dying. Just by turning their heads at the noise, one of their comrades fell lifelessly, pierced somewhere on their body.
From the Solar War era to now, the Myeong tribe never experienced assassination skills on par with Yona. Except for now, no era ever witnessed such assassination skills.
“My brothers! Tighten the formation, no matter how great her stealth skill, if there’s no gap to escape... Cough!”
Currently, the entire 7th floor was sectioned off by compartments, and the Myeong tribe was grouping even tighter. The space was narrow, dark, and filled with concealment materials.
Therefore, Yona killing the Myeong tribe now was no different from popping one insect at a time inside a glass bottle.
{What's going on, 7th floor? Report!}
“Brother Bakarun! That, Cough!”
{Brother!}
“Heh, hello? Are you the boss meat?”

Yona appeared in front of a window, reflected in the bracelet of a recently slain enemy, and locked eyes with Bakarun. Upon seeing Yona's innocent face, Bakarun was momentarily taken aback. Despite having killed so many of his brethren, not a single drop of blood was on Yona's face or clothes.
"It's him! Catch him!"
The enemy who shouted charged at Yona, only to have his throat slashed. Yona was not only good at assassination.
Within close combat, only a handful of people within the alliance could defeat Yona. She was not someone ordinary warriors or mediocre fighters could handle.
"Are you... Yona Runcandel?"
"Yep, you must be Bakarun the meat! Nice to meet you. I want to kill you a little, can you come here? I don't know my way around this fortress. Hee."
[This 7th floor will be your grave.]
Bakarun had no intention of falling for Yona's taunts. Yona's words were merely a casual provocation.
Soon, Bakarun tried to enhance the lockdown orders, but just before closing the window, he caught sight of Eltiot, who had suddenly appeared, and narrowed his eyes.
"Yona, gasp! Gasp! Don't you think you're being too hard on me...?"
"Sister Teacher, you didn't die?"
Eltiot, covered in blood and ashes, had just followed Yona into the fortress.
Blue Wind Emperor...!}
"Hey Bakarun, want to catch us? There's only one way. Start the space jump of the aerial fortress now. Once it returns to your base, even Yona and I will have a hard time escaping, won't we?"
At those words, Bakarun bared his teeth in anger and terminated the communication.
"You made Bakarun the meat end the call."
"Oh Yona... Don't you have anything else to say to me?"
"Um, well done?"

"Sigh, yes, that's enough. Anyway, Yona, because of what I just said, he will try to avoid executing the space jump. In reality, that's the most dangerous for us, but since we told him to do that, he'll feel awkward and try another response first..."
Before Eltiot could finish speaking, the inside of the fortress suddenly began to vibrate.
"Heh, well, this time my cunning didn't work. I never thought Bakarun would prepare for a space jump right away."
The vibration was the result of the fortress amplifying its energy to open a large dimensional gate. It was trying to take the two back to its base.
Yona reflexively pressed a blade to Eltiot's throat.
"Yona, isn't this a bit much? We can just escape and wait for the next opportunity."
"Hee, then I can't give a gift to my youngest."
"What can we do then?"
"How long will it take? The space jump."
"We can't use up all our energy supporting the Shimat, so at the fastest, 5 minutes, and at the latest, 7 minutes."
"Then let's head to the 6th floor now. According to the map you gave me, if we break through the barrier ahead, there's a passage to the 6th floor."
Eltiot looked down at the blade touching her throat and sighed.
"I think you, Yona, need to learn a little more about the world from now on."
Of course, Yona had no intention of stabbing Eltiot.
But she did not expect Eltiot to twist the blade with her finger before Yona pulled it away.
"What!? Hee?"
The upright blade turned diagonally. Yona momentarily lost her balance and put some distance between herself and Eltiot, for she had never experienced anything like this.
Even Jin wouldn't have been able to deflect her blade so easily in such a situation, she thought.

"Heehee, are you surprised? The movement I just showed can only be done by someone who lives in perfect harmony with the world. Yona, understanding others' hearts is also part of harmony with the world. Do you think Jin would want you to risk your life to get a part as a gift?"
"But I want to give a gift."

"The fact that you and Jin read each other's thoughts without communicating earlier is a gift itself. And the fact that the red ones are trying to take the fortress out of the desert because of us is an achievement. So let's not push it and go back."
"Just one barrier to break, then..."
"Ti-ack!"
"Hee!"
"Te-ack!"
"Hee-hee!"
"Let's go back."
"Okay!"
So Eltiot and Yona decided not to push any further and escape from the Patle.
The crack they used to invade had already been restored with a protective barrier formed by the enemy's brainwave. Eltiot once again nullified the protective barrier by placing her palm on it.
However, she also spat out a mouthful of blood. Her weakened body was not suitable for consecutive battles.
Seeing this, Yona unconsciously took out a bandage, and Eltiot smiled proudly.
She thought that breaking down the wall between Yona and the world would be more rewarding than helping Luna break the Wall of Genesis.
"Hmm, as expected, the outside is full of enemy brainwave waves. Even if you're Yona, running through it would hurt you."
"I won't get hurt?"
Eltiot didn't answer, naturally carrying Yona on her back. Yona was simply fascinated by how Eltiot kept moving beyond her expectations.
"It doesn't seem that fast, what's this? If I had a sword in my hand, I could have cut you, right? What is this? How is this possible?"

"If I had intended to cut you, there would be blood on that hand, and you wouldn't be able to move like this with blood on it. You're already doing it but don't know yourself well. Once you know, your assassination skills may actually decrease a bit."
"Heh, then that's bad."
"It's bad as an assassin but better as a human. You don't need to hold my shoulder too tightly. Just take me down without hurting me, Eltiot."
Eltiot and Yona started descending outside the tower.
Outside, the atmosphere was filled with enemy brainwaves, Luna's sword energy, and the electric energy of Jin and Shimat, covering both the ground and the sky.
Occasionally, sharp energy protruding from those enormous waves of power grazed some part of Eltiot's body.
But it never touched Yona, who was carried on his back. Yona enjoyed the wind called Eltiot, as if dreaming a fun dream.
By the time the two reached the ground, the tower had formed a large-scale dimensional gate as planned.
It looked like a red sea had opened in the sky. The giant dimensional gate was swirling, enveloping the airborne fortress and fleet.
The enemy species had decided to retreat for now. They hadn't suffered significant damage, but the variable of the three summoned demons disturbed them.
"Let's stop for today, Jin Runcandel."
Shimat said, striking Jin's sword away.
Jin didn't persistently cling to Shimat either, thinking that the demons' 'power absorption' might affect Lafrarosa.
Above all, the enemy's airborne fortress had already fully loaded its main cannon. As they were lagging in mobility, the alliance could only continue to fight when the enemy wanted to.
Fortunately for the Vamel Alliance, the battlefield was expected to be fixed in the desert for a while.
Jin did not answer but began to rush towards where Luna, Yona, and Eltiot were to withdraw while bearing the main cannon of the airborne fortress.
Kwaaaaa...!

The airborne fortresses dropped their main cannons and disappeared beyond the dimensional gate. Jin and his party began to escape through the enemy's brainwave cannon, spreading their sword barriers to protect Eltiot.
[Kuahahaha!]
[Incredible power! Oh, if we absorb power like this every day, we'll be strong as before soon!]
Meanwhile, the Sribi party laughed, absorbing the main cannons of the airborne fortresses as if taking medicine. Due to the distance, Jin and his party did not see this.
However, Jin could feel a familiar force spreading from the Sribi party's direction within the oppressive enemy brainwave cannon.
'Is this, the energy of my brothers...!?'
It was faint, but what Jin felt was undoubtedly the energy used by the King's tribe of Lafrarosa.
Soon, that power was absorbed into the souls of the Sribi party and disappeared, and Jin and his party safely escaped the enemy's brainwave cannon and left the desert.
